title: Chapter 376: A Terrifying Monster
content:
Chapter 376: A Terrifying Monster

No matter who happens to this sudden dark creature, it must be the work of God.

It can only be the work of God.

Because he greatly alleviated the current danger of their three gods.

Their faith in God will not decrease.

God, sooner or later, will protect them!

This self-deception method quickly began to spread among the entire three gods. For a moment, the originally panicked gods began to slowly quiet down.

Of course, they won't do nothing.

It is better to seek oneself than to ask others. If you want to deal with the human race, they must be prepared for both.

On the other side.

At the boundary of the chaos.

At this moment, the originally hazy chaotic boundary has now turned into hell, with strange black creatures everywhere, and the air is filled with a strong smell of blood and disgusting smell.

The dim sky became extremely depressing.

What is even more terrifying is that the entire Chaos Realm boundary has lost the constraints of the Supreme Law.

Nowadays, this place has become an illegal place.

Buzz —

At this time, a ripples suddenly appeared in the space.

The next moment, waves appeared, and two beautiful figures slowly walked out of the fluctuations in the space, as if they were moving from two-dimensional to three-dimensional.

"Hey, it's really disgusting."

Seeing the scene in front of him, Jiang Xiaoxiao couldn't help but complain, and her frown deeply expressed her disgust for this place.

The appearance here made her unconsciously think of the God who Lu Daosheng took her to when he was in the Lanxing period.

There, there seems to be some similarities to here.

Next to Jiang Xiaoxiao, Lu Xue stood quietly here. Her delicate, flawless face was also full of disgust and a deep sense of anxiety.

"Aunt, where is that monster?"

Lu Xue's voice was slightly heavy. She just wanted her aunt to solve this monster now.

According to Jiang Xiaoxiao's words, this monster is still getting stronger and seems to be very fast.

If this continues, if even her aunt is no match for her, then they will be finished.

She never wanted this to happen.

Hearing Lu Xue's words, Jiang Xiaoxiao pointed his hand deep into the border, "That guy is inside, and,,"

Jiang Xiaoxiao's voice was a little hesitant.

“It seems to be still sleeping.”

Sleeping!

When Lu Xue heard this sentence, she suddenly felt a little incredible.

Just sleeping can cause such a big disturbance. If you wake up, don’t you turn the Chaos Realm to the bottom? !

No, no, you must not let it go.

Immediately, Lu Xue quickly spoke, "Aunt, you can kill it now?"

"If it's a little later, I'm afraid,"

"What are you afraid of? I'm afraid I can't beat this guy?"

Jiang Xiaoxiao had a playful smile on her face.

Since her cultivation level soared by Lu Daosheng, she has now become extremely confident, because so far, she has never seen anyone better than her except Lu Daosheng.

In a sense, she is invincible.

This is the daughter of the father, can’t you show off?

Looking at Lu Xue's face worried and nodded slightly, Jiang Xiaoxiao smiled confidently, "Don't worry Xiaoxue, give it another ten thousand years, it is no match for me."

As he spoke, Jiang Xiaoxiao spread her palms out, and a pure and powerful force gradually condensed from her hands.

I saw Jiang Xiaoxiao take a step forward and look back at Lu Xue.

"Your aunt, I am invincible in this world."

Buzz —

In an instant, the power in Jiang Xiaoxiao's hand shot towards the depths of the border.

The entire Chaos Realm boundary seemed to be distorted because it could not bear this force, and the entire space began to overlap and shatter.

pound!

With a deafening sound, a huge mushroom cloud surged deep in the border.

What followed was the huge vibration that spread throughout the Chaos Realm.

"So strong."

In the human territory, An Chang was looking in that direction, and the admiration in his eyes was almost beyond words.

Although Wu Shang and Huo Xingzhi on the side did not speak, their faces were extremely solemn.

At this time, the space beside you suddenly trembled.

The shadow leader slowly emerged.

He had an excited smile on his face, his eyes staring at the direction of the border, dancing.

"Hahaha, this patriarch knows that if I follow the human race, how can a mere monster appear suddenly shake the determination of the patriarch to follow the human race!"

Immediately afterwards, the leader of the Shadow Clan bowed to the three of them and said, "Don't worry, three sirs. I will lead the entire Shadow Clan to continue to put pressure on the small world of the God Clan."

"In three days, you will definitely be able to break it!"

Seeing the Shadow Clan leader so active, Huo Xingzhi smiled and stepped forward and patted his shoulder, "Good job, then, the Lord of the Palace will be able to reward merits. As the Shadow Clan leader, you will be rewarded with merits. It's indispensable."

Hearing this, the leader of the Shadow Clan suddenly felt flattered and waved his hand quickly, "Don't dare, this is what my Shadow Clan should do."

Rumble!

And at this moment, another vibration sound came from the border.

The few people quickly looked at it, and their expressions fell into a solemn look again.

The leader of the Shadow Clan frowned slightly, "This monster's vitality is so tenacious. It's enough to be proud to be able to hold on to Master Jiang's hand."

Faced with the sudden flattery of the Shadow Clan leader, the three of them remained indifferent and just looked in that direction heavily.

Here we are coming, getting closer and closer!

Click—

The space is broken.

A woman covered in blood and pale face hugged Lu Xue and rushed out of the crack in the space.

"aunt!"

Lu Xue quickly supported Jiang Xiaoxiao who was about to fall to the ground.

At this moment, everyone present was stunned, and a deep despair followed.

Jiang Xiaoxiao gasped heavily and the blood flowed from her mouth.

What is creepy is that all the blood that Jiang Xiaoxiao shed was black blood and had a stimulating smell.

Looking at Jiang Xiaoxiao at this time, Lu Xue was worried and her eyes were moist.

Jiang Xiaoxiao grinned, but her smile was very forced.

"Xiaoxue, sorry, I disappoint you."

I didn't expect that this monster is so fucking strong! ! !

Jiang Xiaoxiao wailed in her heart, then she rolled her eyes and fainted.

Since she took action, not only her, but Lu Xue, all thought that the monster was dead.

Such terrifying power is probably unstoppable to the entire Chaos Realm.

But an accident happened anyway.

Under this power, the monster was only slightly injured and recovered in the blink of an eye.

More importantly, under Jiang Xiaoxiao's attack, the monster woke up early!

After the monster woke up, Jiang Xiaoxiao realized how powerful this monster was.

At that moment, her first reaction was to escape.

But she was eventually motivated by the seedlings and had very little practical experience.

Plus, I just put down my bold words.

Under Lu Xue's gaze, she gritted her teeth.

Then, one move was severely damaged.

She was seriously injured and hurriedly escaped with Lu Xue.
